This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. The bipedal [[humanoid]] sentient species was distinguished by their enlarged craniums, [[Color|blue]] skin, and white markings on their faces, as well as a lack of visible [[ear]]s.<ref name="Chapter 9" /> In [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate}}</ref>, a member of this species was present at [[Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk]], fleeing when [[Gor Koresh|Koresh]] attempted to take [[Din Djarin]]'s [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin's armor|armor]].<ref name="Chapter 9" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:EnlargedCraniumConcept-DisneyGalleryTheMandalorian-MakingOfSeason2.jpg|right|200px|thumb|Concept art for this species]]
This species made their debut in the [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|ninth episode]] of the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', written and directed by [[Jon Favreau]].<ref name="Chapter 9" /> Another [[Unidentified enlarged-cranium purple species|similar species]] appeared within the [[2021]] series, ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'',actually possessing visible ears<ref name="BOBF1">{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}}</ref>  like the original concept art for this species.<ref name="Gallery">{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian: Making of Season Two|Making of Season Two}}</ref>
